newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - Politics hits India after week of woe.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - Politics hits India after week of woe.

text.p: Political infighting in India after the Congress Party threatened to undo the ruling coalition government undermined Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) in London.
"The market was marked lower across the board," said a trader.

The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed down 3.31 points, 5.31 percent, at 59.05 points, with the premium over the local market at 6.86 percent, compared after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell 98.86 points or 3.17 percent to 3,002.86.

Former premier P.V. Narasimha Rao, who faces prosecution charges and could cease to be Congress party leader could trigger a realignment as disgruntled former Congress activists return to the party, which would endanger the ruling United Front-Left Front coalition.
"Find me a buyer," said a trader.
New issue State Bank of India closed down 50 cents from Friday at $13.75/$14.25.

SBI's successful issue last week sapped strength from the market, after Indian authorities said that the deal of up to $450 million would count towards the foreign shareholding limit of 20 percent in the company.
Elswehere in Asia, the Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 1.75 points, 2.61 percent, at 68.93, a premium of 26.83 percent over the local market.
The Korea Composite Index added 18.02 points to 795.33.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended little changed, up 0.15 points at 68.93, a premium of 2.26 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 24.24 points 6,620.42.
